description: Structural compression engine (Headroom strategies in pure TS). SAFETY: input mode is lossless-only by default to protect model reasoning; output mode may use lossy strategies.

input.note: Input/prompt path: only lossless strategies (tabular compaction) by default. Lossy row/prose dropping is disabled to avoid degrading model reasoning. Set allowLossy=true only when token budget is critical.

output.note: Output path: lossy strategies OK (model already reasoned). Compressed output becomes next-turn context, so lossy is acceptable here.
